headline.en: Precision Volumetric Analysis with Drone Technology
headline.sw: Uchambuzi Sahihi wa Kiasi kwa Teknolojia ya Ndege Zisizo na Rubani

description.en:
SmartGrid leverages advanced UAVs and photogrammetry to deliver fast, accurate volumetric measurements.

 Whether you’re managing stockpiles, quarries, or earthworks, our drone solutions cut time and cost while enhancing safety and data reliability.
description.sw:
SmartGrid hutumia UAV za hali ya juu na photogrammetry kutoa vipimo vya kiasi vya haraka, sahihi.

 Iwe unasimamia mrundikano, machimbo, au kazi za ardhi, suluhisho zetu za ndege hupunguza muda na gharama huku zikiboresha usalama na uaminifu wa data.

description.en: Say goodbye to outdated manual surveys. Our drone-based volume calculations bring clarity and control to every project milestone.
description.sw: Sema kwaheri kwa uchunguzi wa kizamani wa mikono. Hesabu zetu za kiasi za ndege zisizo na rubani huleta uwazi na udhibiti katika kila hatua muhimu ya mradi.

headline.en:
Whether you're a government agency, an NGO, or a private developer, Smartgrid Surveying is your trusted partner!

 Our drones deliver actionable data where it matters most.
headline.sw:
Iwe wewe ni wakala wa serikali, shirika lisilo la kiserikali, au msanidi binafsi, Smartgrid Surveying ni mshirika wako wa kuaminika!

 Ndege zetu zisizo na rubani hutoa data inayoweza kutekelezwa mahali inapohitajika zaidi.

description.en: Quick and safe volumetric data for materials like gravel, sand, and coal — reducing the need for manual measurement and risk.
description.sw: Data ya kiasi ya haraka na salama kwa nyenzo kama changarawe, mchanga, na makaa—kupunguza hitaji la kipimo cha mikono na hatari.

description.en: Track cut/fill volumes and changes over time with high-resolution terrain data captured from above.
description.sw: Fuatilia kiasi cha kukata/kujaza na mabadiliko kwa muda kwa data ya ardhi ya mwonekano wa juu iliyokamatwa kutoka juu.

title.sw: Ufuatiliaji wa Maendeleo ya Kazi za Ardhi

description.en: Compare as-built models against designs to monitor progress and confirm excavation volumes with centimeter-level accuracy.
description.sw: Linganisha mifano ya as-built dhidi ya mibuni kufuatilia maendeleo na kuthibitisha kiasi cha uchimbaji kwa usahihi wa kiwango cha sentimita.

description.en: Generate detailed 3D models to determine how much material needs to be removed or added—ideal for grading and leveling.
description.sw: Zalisha mifano ya kina ya 3D kuamua ni kiasi gani cha nyenzo kinahitaji kuondolewa au kuongezwa—bora kwa usawazishaji na kusawazisha.

description.en: Compare datasets over time for performance reviews, billing verification, and regulatory compliance.
description.sw: Linganisha seti za data kwa muda kwa hakiki za utendaji, uthibitishaji wa bili, na kufuata kanuni.

description.en: Audit-ready volumes and quantities for earthworks and stockpiles:
description.sw: Vina na wingi tayari kwa ukaguzi kwa kazi za ardhi na makusanyo:

description.en: Cut and fill quantities with surfaces, methodology and tolerance clearly documented.
description.sw: Wingi wa kuchimba na kujaza pamoja na nyuso, mbinu na uvumilivu vilivyoelezwa wazi.

description.en: Individual and cumulative stockpile volumes, with densities applied on request.
description.sw: Vina vya makusanyo binafsi na jumla, huku wiani ukitumika unapohitajika.

description.en: Base and comparison surfaces that make every volume computation repeatable and defensible.
description.sw: Nyuso za msingi na za kulinganisha zinazofanya kila kokotoo la vina kurudiwa na kuaminika.

description.en: Contour plans of pre- and post-works terrain for design, records and compliance.
description.sw: Ramani za contour za ardhi kabla na baada ya kazi kwa usanifu, kumbukumbu na ufuasi.

title.sw: Ripoti za Maendeleo ya Kazi za Ardhi

description.en: Periodic cut and fill movement reports aligned to payment applications and programmes.
description.sw: Ripoti za mara kwa mara za kuchimba na kujaza zinazolingana na maombi ya malipo na programu.

title.sw: Vifurushi vya Data za CAD na GIS

description.en: Surfaces, contours and volumes exported in open formats for CAD and GIS workflows.
description.sw: Nyuso, contour na vina vilivyoagizwa kwa miundo wazi kwa mchakato wa CAD na GIS.
